set.body:
Scope:
Add optional otel4s instrumentation driven by authoritative TaskRecord and lifecycle transitions, with a no-op default and explicit cardinality control.

Acceptance criteria:
- Metrics cover queued/running/settled counts, success/failure/interruption/unknown/publication-failure totals, queue wait, execution, result promotion, artifact publication, and requested/effective resource gauges where meaningful.
- Every metric documents the typed transition and timestamp authority from which it is derived.
- Metric recording does not mutate task lifecycle state or introduce a competing event stream.
- Operation labels use stable id/version fields; user-controlled high-cardinality labels are excluded or folded into a tested _other series under a configurable hard cap.
- Telemetry backend construction is passed as Resource and defaults to no-op.
- Metrics remain correct under idempotent reattachment, retries, cancellation races, cache hits, and process restart projections.
- Deterministic tests inspect emitted points without requiring an external collector.
set.title: SOJ.O2: Instrument bounded OpenTelemetry from typed transitions
